"""Verify actual V153 preparation bytes and current live handles, without inference."""

import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root = repo / '.cache/quality-20261103/V153-delivered-objective-v1'
publication = repo / 'docs/results/v153-delivered-objective-preparation-v1.json'
p = read(publication)
assert len(p['copies']) == 13
for binding in p['copies'].values():
    assert ref(binding['original']['path']) == binding['original']
    assert ref(binding['public']['path']) == binding['public']
    assert Path(binding['original']['path']).read_bytes() == Path(binding['public']['path']).read_bytes()
source = read(p['sources']['path'])
assert ref(p['sources']['path']) == p['sources']
assert len(source['frozen_neural_hashes']) == len(source['previous86_neural_hashes_unchanged']) == 86
for path, sha in source['frozen_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(path)['sha256'] == ref(repo / 'src/demosaic' / Path(path).name)['sha256'] == sha
    assert source['previous86_neural_hashes_unchanged'][Path(path).name] == sha
assert len(source['sources']) == 18
for binding in source['sources'] + [source['publisher']]:
    assert ref(binding['path'])['sha256'] == binding['sha256']
    assert Path(binding['path']).read_text() == binding['text']
plan = read(root / 'plan-v1.json')
guard(plan)
guard(read(root / 'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
design = read(root / 'quality-design-v1.json')
previous_design = read(Path(plan['previous']) / 'quality-design-v1.json')
assert design['observations'] == previous_design['observations']
assert len(design['observations']) == 822 and len(design['endpoints']) == 6
assert design['new_component_forwards'] == 4932
adc = [c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort') in ['adc-photo256', 'adc-sloped512']]
assert len(adc) == 24 and sum(c['kind'] == 'photo' for c in adc) == 8
assert all(c['reference_role'].startswith('Exact ') for c in adc)
for case in adc:
    assert ref(case['arrays']['path']) == case['arrays']
    assert ref(case['parent']['path']) == case['parent']
assert read(root / 'checkpoint250-audit-v1.json')['finite_Adam_states'] == 39
parity = read(root / 'parity-result-v1.json')
assert len(parity['rows']) == 28 and parity['component_forward_evaluations'] == 56
smoke = read(root / 'smoke-result-v1.json')
arms = ['pre-control', 'delivered-mosaic', 'delivered-RGB']
assert smoke['counts'] == smoke['updates'] == dict.fromkeys(arms, 10)
assert smoke['supervised_batches'] == dict.fromkeys(arms, 7)
assert smoke['zero_ADC_gradient_batches'] == dict.fromkeys(arms, 3)
assert all(len(v) == 13 and min(v.values()) > 0 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
snapshot = read(root / 'preparation-snapshot-v1.json')
assert snapshot['completed_control_trace_rows_exact_V152'] == 261
assert snapshot['ADC_zero_loss_and_norm_rows_per_arm'] == 30
live = {}
for name, observed in snapshot['owners_confirmed_live'].items():
    owner = observed['owner']
    process = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
    assert abs(process.create_time() - owner['created']) < .01
    assert process.is_running() and process.status() not in ['zombie', 'dead']
    live[name] = {'owner': owner, 'status': process.status(), 'CPU_times': process.cpu_times()._asdict()}
trace = [json.loads(s) for s in (root / 'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True) if s.endswith(b'\n')]
old = read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for row, previous in zip(trace, old[:len(trace)], strict=True):
    assert row['arms']['pre-control'] == previous['arms']['relative-phase']
    assert row['step'] == previous['step'] and row['batch'] == previous['batch'] and row['domain'] == previous['domain']
docs = ['README.md', 'docs/index.md', 'docs/current-model.md', 'docs/research.md',
        'docs/experiments.md', 'docs/support-crossover.md', 'docs/delivered-spectral-objective.md',
        'diary/2026-11-03-18-00-31-v153-delivered-spectral-objective.md']
links = 0
for name in docs:
    path = repo / name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):
            continue
        assert (path.parent / link.split('#')[0]).is_file(), (name, link)
        links += 1
assert not (root / 'train-result-v1.json').exists()
save(repo / 'docs/results/v153-delivered-objective-preparation-verification-v1.json', {
    'status': 'pass-active-preparation-and-document-publication',
    'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'preparation': ref(publication),
    'byte_exact_receipt_copies': 13, 'frozen_and_current_neural_hashes_matching': 86,
    'previous_neural_hashes_unchanged': 86, 'source_texts_checked': 18,
    'case_count': 822, 'ADC_controls': 24,
    'planned_endpoints': 6, 'planned_native_primary_figures': 84,
    'current_complete_control_trace_rows_exact_V152': len(trace),
    'document_links_checked': links, 'live_owners': live,
    'documents': {name: ref(repo / name) for name in docs},
    'verifier': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope': 'Active preparation/control verification only. Snapshot261 rows and checkpoint250 receipts remain byte-exact. Three recorded original controller/worker handles verified live now; no process restart. No final weights/quality claim,neural inference or noise calls.',
})
print(f'PASS: 13 copies, 86 unchanged neural hashes, 18 source texts, {len(trace)} exact control rows, {links} links, 3 live owners')

scope: Active preparation/control verification only. Snapshot261 rows and checkpoint250 receipts remain byte-exact. Three recorded original controller/worker handles verified live now; no process restart. No final weights/quality claim,neural inference or noise calls.
